title: Suspiciously unboring.
lines: Either you're already doing this right, or you were very kind to yourself.
A free audit will tell us which. Bring your competitors' pages too.

title: Boring-ish.
lines: There's something good in there, buried under the safe stuff.
That's the easiest kind of brand to fix. Let's dig it out.

title: Certified boring.
lines: Good news: there's nowhere to go but memorable.
Bad news: your competitors can take this test too.
